med-patient-medication-reminder v1.0.0

- Initial release for patient-side chronic disease medication reminders, referencing the MedTimer app.
- Supports medication name, dose, frequency, reminder times, start/end dates, and status inputs.
- Generates structured medication reminder schedules and allows marking reminder status.
- Supports output of today's reminder list.
- Accepts multiple input formats: JSON, CSV, Excel, text, DOC, PDF, and image (with OCR).
- Uses an internal medical AI model for analysis and reminder generation.
